Use case: style-transfer. Make one heritage atlas plate. IMAGE 1 is ONLY the Longmen thin-black-line STYLE master; following photographs determine this subject's geometry, NOT their scene. Draw fine sparse BLACK contours, deliberately simplified joints, a few selected roof/stone detail lines. Every non-ink pixel inside and outside the object is perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. No filled black shadows, grayscale, hatching, color, paper grain, gradient, glow, checkerboard, frame, caption, watermark or lettering. Plaques remain blank. Remove tourists, modern fences, cables, trees, sky, paving, other buildings and all ground shadows. Full uncut subject, apex and own base intact, centered with at least 8% clear margins. This is a faithful present-object illustration, not a speculative reconstruction.

NONG'AN Liao Pagoda in Jilin, not Liaoyang or Chongxing. Follow PHOTO2 lower body geometry and PHOTO3 eave details; PHOTO4 overall present tower silhouette. Octagonal grey-brick densely-eaved tower, EXACTLY THIRTEEN eaves TOTAL INCLUDING broad FIRST eave above tall plain body, plus12upper eaves. Body is a comparatively plain tall masonry octagon, arched real/false door openings and vertical relief pilaster lines, NOT the lavish Buddha figure gallery of Chongxing tower. Preserve very dense simulated timber-bracket brick bands at eaves and present elongated stacked lotus/cap and metal ringed finial. Short brick stepped plinth visible along left front, no speculative giant terrace. Remove foreground heritage stele, park, trees, other towers and people. Full tower height84% portrait1024x1536.
